Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Deliver projects related to pricing plans and billing
  • Develop our billing integration with third party services, strengthening our end-to-end billing experience.
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core billing software components.
  • Integrate with third-party billing platforms (e.g., Stripe, Metronome) as needed
  • Develop metering, pricing, and rating logic for usage-based and subscription billing models.
  • Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of customer usage data.
  • Monitor and maintain billing systems to ensure high availability and data integrity.
  • Build automation tools for recurring billing tasks, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with product, sales, and finance teams to support custom billing requirements.
  • Work closely with finance, product, support, and engineering teams to support accurate billing, revenue reporting, and customer inquiries.
  • Act as a technical expert in billing-related discussions and planning.
  • Champion engineering excellence by driving code quality, architectural reviews, and design documentation.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.
  • Establish observability, alerting, and error handling across the billing pipeline to ensure high availability and responsiveness.
  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for billing-related issues.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience in backend software engineering, with a strong focus on billing, payments, or financial systems.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS billing models, including subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration, discounts, and entitlements.
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, etc, or building custom billing systems.
  • Experience designing and managing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proficient with SQL and data modeling, especially for financial and usage data.
  • Solid understanding of APIs and experience building or integrating internal billing APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, or comfortable writing production-quality code in another language and eager to work with Go
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range

$143,000—$179,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! *Required: 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on backend development Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language, with interest in learning Java which is the main language used by the team Knowledge of engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle, including testing and DevOps standards Strong written and spoken English: you'll regularly propose and discuss ideas and implementation details with teammates and involve stakeholders across Twilio. Desired: Experience with Java frameworks such as Spring, Hibernate, or Dropwizard Some experience with, or willingness to learn, front-end development Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration Experience with cloud platforms Experience working in agile teams Experience documenting solutions and proposals Location This role will be remote, and based in Ireland. Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer.

This position is needed to build and maintain reliable applications for Twilio’s Supply Management platform. The emphasis is on back-end development, but also includes front-end for internal tools.

As a Software Engineer in the team, you will be collaborating with product managers, architects, engineering managers and other engineers to develop features for Supply Management products. You'll automate manual tasks, build new operational tools, and add capabilities to our internal applications, all in service of a high-quality experience for Twilio's customers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy features alongside a small, distributed, collaborative team to build reliable and resilient services

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply.   • Strong written and spoken English: you'll regularly propose and discuss ideas and implementation details with teammates and involve stakeholders across Twilio.

  • Some experience with, or willingness to learn, front-end development
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration
  • Experience with cloud platforms
  • Experience working in agile teams
  • Experience documenting solutions and proposals

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

raw.jobDescription:
About Enode

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our platform connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on.

Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode: retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters.

AI is fundamental to how we work

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. People who care about unblocking others, not just about what they ship themselves. If that's not quite how you work yet but it's the direction you're heading, we'd still like to hear from you. We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

What we're looking for:

We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer for our new Deployment team. The team works inside Europe's largest energy retailers, deep in their software architecture, to turn Enode's platform into infrastructure that enables steering large fleets of residential load. A retailer's charging data arrives in several formats from a few legacy systems and their team has been blocked for weeks: you are the person who unblocks them.

You'll join as one of the first members of the team, working directly with our Head of Deployment, Ben Brandt. There is no playbook yet, and you'll help write it. Every deployment should make the next one faster.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical delivery of customer deployments from discovery to production: understand the customer's architecture, scope the work, sequence it and flag blockers early

  • Sit with customer architects and earn the right to change how their systems work

  • Write production code in the customer's environment and in Enode, and know which is which. Anything we would build twice becomes Enode code.

  • Build agents, harnesses, customer-facing MCP servers and tooling that make every deployment faster than the last

  • Run your work with AI in the loop, and turn what works into something the team can reuse

  • Turn what you see in the field into concrete ideas for product and engineering to become part of the core product

  • Travel to customer sites for up to 50% of your time

This role will be right for you if:

  • You have 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real contact with customers or users, ideally as a forward-deployed engineer at large Enterprises

  • AI is how you work by default, in and outside of work, and you can raise the bar of people who already consider themselves advanced

  • You're technically credible with enterprise architects, including in messy legacy environments

  • You get more excited by the customer's outcome than by the most elegant technical solution

  • You're comfortable in high ambiguity and take ownership of large pieces of work

  • You can tell a customer they are wrong, and be proven right

  • You're genuinely interested in the energy transition

  • Bonus: experience in energy, mobility or connected devices; early-engineer or founder experience; a forward-deployed background, for example at Palantir; fluency in another major European language

What we offer:

  • Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale.

  • A mission-driven, fun and caring environment with high drive and ambition.

  • Competitive compensation, including a very attractive employee option program - you’re part of our journey.

  • Access to best in class AI tooling, we think the ceiling on what a small team can do has fundamentally shifted, and we want you to feel that.

  • Real investment in your AI fluency. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly.

  • Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand.

  • Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places.

  • Flexible, human-first culture.

  • Stipend for setting up your home office.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A few things to note:

  • Enode is an equal opportunities employer. Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Our values are integral to the way we work and are embedded into all our hiring processes. You can read more about our values here.

raw.jobDescription:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.

The Consumer Web Product team owns web shopping experiences for one of NerdWallet's largest and most mission-critical verticals, serving millions of users making real financial decisions. You'll work across a modern full-stack: Next.js and React on the frontend, GraphQL federation and Node.js services on the backend, deployed on edge infrastructure built for scale and speed. Page performance and Core Web Vitals directly move rankings, conversion, and revenue, so the technical work here has a visible, measurable business impact. We build fast, and we build with data: rapid product-led experimentation, direct input into the company's strategic roadmap, and close collaboration with Paid Marketing and SEO strategists to turn engineering decisions into business outcomes.

If you thrive on high-impact work, solving technical challenges, and shaping the future of financial shopping experiences on the web, this is the place for you.

We're looking for a hands-on player coach Tech Lead Manager to lead the Consumer Facing Web Product team. You act as a pace setter and multiplier for the team, helping to mentor and build your team up to your standards of execution. You'll be deeply involved with the technical day-to-day of the team, helping the team to deliver on the product backlog, contributing to the engineering excellence roadmap, setting architectural direction and ensuring high-quality delivery throughout. You'll be diving in when needed to help set the standards and drive quality. You'll also be responsible for the people management for a team of 3-4 engineers: 1-on-1s, career development and performance management. You bring strong technical judgement to the role, having experience being the senior-most engineer on your team. You avoid micromanagement, choosing to lead through influence and mutual respect rather than authority. You're as excited about delivering high-quality work as you are finding opportunities to unlock growth for your people.

You embrace AI development tools and modern engineering practices, focusing on balancing quality with delivery velocity. You're using AI tools to reshape the Software Development Lifecycle, delegating as much to your team as you are to agentic workflows. You will help the team build out a robust AI developer harness, utilize a consistent spec-driven development workflow and integrate AI skills into every facet of process: from architecture & planning to development, QA, code review and release. You are creating agentic workflows to automate away the toil from your day to day, as well as your team's, with the right guardrails in place to keep quality and compliance high as you go.

You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders from across the organization, including: SEO strategists, Paid Marketers, Product, Business Development, Data & Analytics, etc. to drive meaningful business value, focusing your efforts on growing the business rather than engineering for the sake of it.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering for Consumer Banking, Credit Cards & New Markets.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Own both the technical direction and the people outcomes for a team building some of NerdWallet's highest-traffic web shopping experiences.

  • Drive architecture, technical decisions, planning, and milestones.

  • Build and evolve the team's AI dev harness and orchestrate agentic automations across the software lifecycle, from spec to review to deployment.

  • Develop your engineers' AI-era skills: effective prompting, spec-writing, and reviewing AI-generated code and designs.

  • Manage and develop your engineers: run 1:1s, give feedback, set growth plans, and hold a performance bar.

  • Take input from and partner directly with engineering leadership to drive technical initiatives that enhance performance, observability, scalability, security, and developer experience.

  • Contribute to platform stability and resilience through effective monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.

  • Ensure high standards of technical excellence, maintaining a high-quality codebase and driving modernization efforts including AI tooling adoption.

Your experience:

We recognize not everyone will meet all of the criteria. If you meet most of the criteria below and you're excited about the opportunity and willing to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years in software engineering with a strong background as a hands-on Technical Lead.

  • Expertise in TypeScript, React and Node.js, with experience in additional modern languages.

  • Strong experience with modern front-end frameworks such as Next.js and React.js, with an understanding of web performance, Core Web Vitals, and technical SEO.

  • Experience architecting and building back-end APIs and microservices, with a focus on scalability, performance, and data integrity.

  • Strong understanding of database systems (both SQL and NoSQL), with experience in high-volume data processing.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Knowledge of security and compliance best practices, particularly in financial services.

  • Experience in observability and running production applications, especially marketplaces, at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with AI development tools and advanced AI-enabled development workflows: building a development harness, agentic automations / workflows, spec-driven development, etc.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience with integrating Machine Learning systems, personalization pipelines, and data-driven experimentation.

  • Domain knowledge in finance and shopping marketplaces.

  • Understanding of accessibility best practices and a keen eye for usability and user experience.

  • Familiarity with paid and organic search strategies and how engineering decisions impact business outcomes.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision health care plans for employees and their dependents

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Flexible Vacation Time Off + 11 holidays + holiday company shutdown

  • New Parent Leave for employees with a newborn child or a child placed with them for adoption or foster care

  • Mental health support

  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge, and pursue their interests

  • Health and Dependent Care FSA and HSA Plan with monthly NerdWallet contribution

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Cell Phone Stipend, and Wifi Stipend (Only remote Nerds are eligible for the Wifi Stipend)

  • Work from home equipment stipend and co-working space subsidy (Only remote Nerds are eligible for these stipends)

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

  • Our Nerds love to make an impact by paying it forward – Take 8 hours of volunteer time off per quarter and donate to your favorite causes with a company match

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • 401K with 4% company match

  • Be the first to test and benefit from our new financial products and tools

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

  • Disability and Life Insurance with employer-paid premiums

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here.

NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

NerdWallet will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the San Francisco Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice, as well as the Los Angeles Fair Chance Act, which requires this notice.

Strong understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, and system integration. Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities, with demonstrated experience building, testing, and maintaining reliable production applications. Help develop transformative AI-powered capabilities and digital platforms in the $700 billion U.S. home services industry. Work on meaningful, real-world technology initiatives with the opportunity to see your solutions deployed and used. Be part of a high-energy, collaborative team that values innovation, initiative, ownership, and adaptability. Work closely with India-based and US-based teams. Enjoy significant opportunities for learning, professional development, and career growth. Benefit from 100% remote working flexibility and competitive compensation. WIN combines the stability of an established industry leader with the energy and ambition of a technology-driven growth company. We offer talented professionals an opportunity to take ownership, solve meaningful challenges, and contribute to innovations that can reshape our industry.

description: At Veriff 's Biometric Solutions team, we are trying to prove, in real time, that the person on the other side of the screen is real and who they claim to be. Our ML-powered platform uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale our real-time verification services, with security, scalability, and maintainability at the core. You'll help us protect honest people online by: Owning the design and evolution of the architecture for a strategically critical product area, making the calls that shape scalability, security, and maintainability for years Leading transformational architecture work: real-time matching at scale, resilient event-driven services, and the CI/CD and observability foundations that make them dependable Setting and raising engineering standards, and mentoring and growing the engineers around you Partnering closely with other engineers, ML data scientists, and specialists to turn complex identity problems into working products, and driving cross-functional alignment with product and dependency teams Building scalable, maintainable APIs and event-driven services that other teams and external customers depend on You are the right future Veriffian if you have Over 5 years of experience building and operating large-scale applications (ideally in Python) Deep expertise in distributed systems, modular design, and SOLID principles, with a track record of architectural ownership Experience building scalable, maintainable APIs and working with message-queuing concepts Fluency with CI/CD, monitoring, and what it takes to run reliable, high-throughput services in production Comfort with a range of testing strategies for robust, reliable software A working understanding of relational databases and structured logging systems Strong communication and influencing skills, able to align engineers and non-engineers around a technical vision A self-starter mindset that balances both tech and product decisions to come up with a balanced outcome for both customers and engineers.   • Over 5 years of experience building and operating large-scale applications (ideally in Python)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, modular design, and SOLID principles, with a track record of architectural ownership
  • Experience building scalable, maintainable APIs and working with message-queuing concepts
  • Fluency with CI/CD, monitoring, and what it takes to run reliable, high-throughput services in production
  • Comfort with a range of testing strategies for robust, reliable software
  • A working understanding of relational databases and structured logging systems
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to align engineers and non-engineers around a technical vision
  • A self-starter mindset that balances both tech and product decisions to come up with a balanced outcome for both customers and engineers.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and explaining your solutions to non-engineers

  • Some experience working with mobile SDKs (iOS, Android) or Web in React

Our Client

Our client is a leading provider of intelligent software solutions, helping organizations transform how they manage training, compliance, and operational excellence. We are committed to data integrity, performance, and innovation in every product we deliver. As part of our growing data quality team, you’ll help ensure that the data driving our platforms is accurate, secure, and reliable.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Data QA Engineer to safeguard the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of our data ecosystems. In this role, you will tackle the key challenge of validating complex ETL pipelines, ensuring seamless data migrations, and verifying that transformed data reflects true business logic before reaching analytical layers and decision-makers.

Responsibilities

  • Data Validation & Verification: Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across pipelines. Validate ETL processes, referential integrity, constraints, and data normalization.

  • Database Testing: Perform functional testing on stored procedures, triggers, views, and functions. Test data migrations, data warehousing systems, and write complex SQL queries to verify data correctness.

  • ETL & BI Testing: Validate data pipelines, transformations, and business logic within reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to ensure accurate report generation.

  • Automation of Database Tests: Build and maintain automated test scripts for database regression and integration testing.

  • Performance Monitoring: Identify slow-running queries, monitor execution plans, evaluate indexing, and collaborate with DBAs to fine-tune system performance.

  • Collaboration & Quality Standards: Partner with developers, DBAs, data analysts, and product teams to document defects in JIRA/TestRail and drive data quality best practices.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Strong SQL Expertise: Advanced ability to write and execute complex SQL queries for deep data verification and reconciliation.

  • Playwright / Python / Typescript / AI-forward testers

  • ETL & Data Warehouse Testing: Proven experience validating ETL/ELT data pipelines, transformation logic, and data warehousing environments.

  • Database Functional Testing: Hands-on experience testing core database objects such as stored procedures, views, triggers, and functions.

  • Data Integrity & Structure: Solid understanding of data normalization, referential integrity, and data schema validation.

  • QA Lifecycle & Tooling: Practical experience documenting test cases, results, and defects in management tools like JIRA or TestRail.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fundraising) — Remote
description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress. How we work Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated: Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress. If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit. Want to learn more? Read and listen: We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist , NPR , TED , and The Washington Post . We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take. About this role: Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good? raw.jobDescription:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good?

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position:

  • You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty
  • You will work independently, with few constraints
  • You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs:

  1. There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own
  2. Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)
  3. We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are:

  • We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles.

This role is right for you if:

  • You care about our mission
  • You agree with our values
  • You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here).
  • You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.
  • You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year
  • You are fluent in English
  • You have 4+ years of engineering experience
  • You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.
  • You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.
  • You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).
  • You are happy and skilled at working directly with non-engineers on messy, poorly defined, rapidly changing, sometimes boring tasks

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

  • Base Salary: $181,130
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$27,170, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$31,789 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $208,300+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £124,370
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£18,656, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~£21,827 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £143,026+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $112,350
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$16,853, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization's current performance multiplier, this amount would be ~$19,717 in 2025)
  • Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $129,203+
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

  • A positive and supportive team with opportunities for advancement
  • A demonstrated commitment to helping all staff develop and grow
  • A competitive salary, including bonus
  • A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)
  • Unlimited PTO (that we encourage staff to take!)
  • Desk allowance and flexible work location

About this specific hiring process

  • Take-home coding assignment
  • Live Coding (60 mins)
  • Systems Design (60 mins)
  • Project Deep Dive + Behavioral (60 mins)

*It’s possible that there will be adjustments to this interview process. Any changes will be communicated to you during the process.

All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Because the system makes real decisions, like closing an investigation or isolating a host, it has to be right, it has to show its work, and it has to know when to hand off to a person. title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it. You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down. You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence. You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency. Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards. You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal. This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction. AI and agentic engineering Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against. Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for. Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed. Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you. Team, resourcing, and accountability Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product. Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments. Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows. Platform and execution Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend. In the first week, expect to: Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services. Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO. raw.jobDescription:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

  • Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
  • Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
  • Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
  • Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

  • Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

  • Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
  • Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
  • Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
  • Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
  • Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
  • Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
  • Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
  • Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
  • Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
  • Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

Compensation

Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety , digitizing floor plans , preserving coral reef populations , guiding drone flight , and much more . Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment. What You'll Do You'll be tasked with a wide range of projects. Each engineer has a realm they focus on, but we're still small enough that we don't have the luxury of deep specialization. We're looking for technical generalists that aren’t afraid to dive into a new stack or toolchain if the need arises (but JavaScript and Node.js make up the brunt of the existing codebase). Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (which is an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning from image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment) but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, fighting fires, automating internal processes, and open source projects. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role probably won't be a good fit. We run primarily on Firebase and GCS, with some machine learning infrastructure on AWS. We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best! Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed. raw.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do

You’ll be responsible for driving our goals for enabling every developer to build with computer vision. You’re not starting from scratch, over a million developers use Roboflow today. We have the raw materials ready to be molded and scaled by a DevRel leader.

Responsibilities include:

  • Drive awareness and adoption of Roboflow tools in the developer community

  • Develop tools and integrations to help make Roboflow easier and better for software developers to use

  • Build projects that will help improve the bleeding edge of the main Roboflow product

  • Create demos, applications, and technical content while sharing your progress online and promoting Roboflow on social media (ie X, LinkedIn, Twitch, etc)

  • Create content to educate, inspire, and equip technical audiences with tools and techniques that make them better at their craft

  • Work with Product, Engineering, and Design to develop new projects in support of the launch of new features

  • Write guides, examples, and documentation to make our software more accessible and understandable.

  • Be an active participant in communities like HN, relevant subreddits, Discord groups, GitHub Issues, and the Roboflow forum.

You may also have or quickly develop ideas for amplifying and expanding our community even more -- and we can’t wait to support those as well.

Who You Are

  • 4+ years of engineering experience

  • 2 + years of DevRel related experience, preference for products in B2B, AI, cloud, and/or developer tools

  • Track record of shipping software projects with fast adoption and viral growth, either as part of a previous job or on your own

  • Technical background that enables you to build fast and learn new things quickly

  • Translate complex information into engaging and easy-to-understand content, guides, tutorials, examples, and applications

  • End-to-end content creation skillset across written, video, and social media

  • Self-starter with the ability to analyze ambiguous situations, develop a plan, execute and iterate

  • Operate with urgency, build consensus, and lead cross-functional teams.

  • Customer focus and motivated to become an expert on our industry, customers, product, ecosystem, and competitors.

  • Active contributor to communities online and/or in-person

  • Bonus: you currently have an engaged following online and an interest in growing your personal audience

Who You'll Be Working With

You will directly be working with our Marketing Lead, Open Source Lead, co-founders, Product Engineers, and Product Designers.

We are currently a team of 70 team members located all over the US and Europe. Our team’s backgrounds range from high school whiz kids, former founders of technology companies and fashion lines, world-class engineers, CMOs to CEOs, and have experience scaling businesses to millions in revenue. We want to work with exceptional people with a diverse background. At this early stage, you'll have the ability to work cross-functionally with many members of the team and solve a wide array of problems.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco with a mindset of opening more offices as we grow. We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs, work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best. Learn more about how we work at Roboflow.

When You'll Work

We don’t have a particular time-zone preference for this role. We have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every 6 months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools

  • $150/mo Team lunch

  • $500/one time Home office

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have recruiters at Roboflow. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive here. We like to work fast at Roboflow, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

Introduction Phase:

[45m] Meet with hiring manager, Trevor Lynn to assess for overall mindset and skill set

Team Interview Phase:

[2 x 60m] Meet with the team

[30m] Meet with hiring manager

Use this time to review specifics about the job description and ask questions before the project phase begins.

Project Phase:

You’ll build a project with Roboflow within a specified amount of time.

We check references and conduct a background check.

Final Interview Stage:

[60m] Meet with Co-founder & CTO

[60m] Meet with CEO

[30m] Meet with Head of Operations to discuss culture

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply to our Former Founders role or subscribe to our career newsletter by emailing "Subscribe" to operations@roboflow.com. We carefully consider every application, and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere—and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

description: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking. After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers! We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️ 📍London or UK Remote | 💰 Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering About our Engineering Teams: We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company. About our Engineering Teams:

We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨
